question: A $4\ \mu$F capacitor charged to $50$ V is connected to an uncharged $6\ \mu$F capacitor. The common potential and the energy lost are
solution:
Charge is conserved: $V = \dfrac{4 \times 50}{4 + 6} = 20$ V.

Energy lost $= \dfrac{1}{2}\dfrac{C_1C_2}{C_1 + C_2}(V_1 - V_2)^2 = \dfrac{1}{2} \times 2.4 \times 10^{-6} \times 2500 = 3$ mJ.
